---
pagetitle: "Immuta Account Review Process"
params:
  region: "EMEA"
  # "" uses the newest data/opportunities_*.RData; otherwise "YYYY-MM-DD"
  snapshot_date: ""
  # Agenda questions; a relative path is looked up next to this Rmd first
  questions_file: "account_review_questions.md"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    theme: null
    highlight: null
    mathjax: null
---

<!--
Account Transition Review guide (knitted companion to
working_scratch/Account_Transition_Review.md).

Knit from RStudio (Knit button) or:
  rmarkdown::render("working_scratch/Account_Transition_Review.Rmd",
                    output_dir = "output",
                    params = list(region = "EMEA"))

Reads a saved op_list snapshot (data/opportunities_*.RData); it does not call
Salesforce or Looker. Run scripts/main.R first if the snapshot is stale.
The page has an account picker; the agenda questions stay fixed and the
metrics panel beside each segment swaps to the selected account.

The agenda questions (segments, timings, wording, core / if time) are read
from working_scratch/account_review_questions.md at knit time. Edit them
there; see the comment at the top of that file for the format.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(htmltools)

# Project root: IMMUTER_PROJECT_ROOT if set (serve.R/api.R set it), else walk
# up from the Rmd's directory to the ImmuteR DESCRIPTION.
.atr_find_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  d <- normalizePath(start)
  repeat {
    desc <- file.path(d, "DESCRIPTION")
    if (file.exists(desc) && any(grepl("^Package:\\s*ImmuteR", readLines(desc, warn = FALSE))))
      return(d)
    up <- dirname(d)
    if (identical(up, d)) stop("Could not find the ImmuteR project root above ", start)
    d <- up
  }
}
root <- Sys.getenv("IMMUTER_PROJECT_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- .atr_find_root()

# load_all() exposes the unexported helpers (safe_val, fmt_usd,
# .rah_account_records, adoption_rows, ...) this page reuses.
suppressMessages(devtools::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE))

# Snapshot ---------------------------------------------------------------------
snap_pat <- "^opportunities_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.RData$"
snap_file <- if (nzchar(params$snapshot_date)) {
  file.path(root, "data", paste0("opportunities_", params$snapshot_date, ".RData"))
} else {
  snaps <- list.files(file.path(root, "data"), pattern = snap_pat, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(snaps) == 0) stop("No data/opportunities_*.RData snapshot found. Run scripts/main.R first.")
  sort(snaps, decreasing = TRUE)[1]
}
if (!file.exists(snap_file)) stop("Snapshot not found: ", snap_file)
snap_env <- new.env()
load(snap_file, envir = snap_env)
op_list <- snap_env$op_list

as_of <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(op_list$updated))
if (length(as_of) == 0 || is.na(as_of[1])) {
  as_of <- as.Date(sub("^opportunities_(.+)\\.RData$", "\\1", basename(snap_file)))
}
as_of <- as_of[1]

# Per-account records: the same builder the ImmuteR Accounts page uses, so the
# numbers here match the account card shown on screen.
recs <- .rah_account_records(op_list)
recs <- Filter(function(r) identical(as.character(r$region), params$region), recs)
if (length(recs) == 0) stop("No accounts in region '", params$region, "' in ", basename(snap_file))
```

```{r helpers, include=FALSE}
dash <- "—"

# Scalar display value: "-" and "" from Salesforce become an em-dash.
sv <- function(x) {
  x <- if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) NA else x[1]
  if (!is.na(x) && trimws(as.character(x)) %in% c("-", "")) x <- NA
  safe_val(x)[1]
}
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", as.character(x))))
int_fmt <- function(x) {
  x <- num(x)
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x[1])) dash else format(round(x[1]), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
}
is_dash <- function(x) is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x[1]) || identical(as.character(x[1]), dash)
cap1 <- function(x) paste0(toupper(substr(x, 1, 1)), substr(x, 2, nchar(x)))

rows_for <- function(df, name, key = "Account Name") {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || !key %in% names(df)) return(NULL)
  hit <- df[!is.na(df[[key]]) & trimws(as.character(df[[key]])) == trimws(name), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(hit) == 0) NULL else hit
}
rows_for_id <- function(df, id) rows_for(df, id, key = "Account ID")
first_val <- function(df, col) {
  if (is.null(df) || !col %in% names(df)) NA else df[[col]][1]
}

a_link <- function(text, url) {
  if (is.null(url) || length(url) == 0 || is.na(url[1]) || !nzchar(url[1]) || url[1] == dash) return(text)
  tags$a(href = url[1], target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", text)
}

# Stoplight dot from any "<colour>: ..." value.
dot <- function(value) {
  col <- pbac_rating_colour(value)
  tags$span(class = paste("dot", if (nzchar(col)) col else "none"))
}
dotted <- function(value, label = sv(value)) tags$span(class = "dotted", dot(value), label)

kv <- function(label, value, wide = FALSE) {
  tags$div(class = paste("kv", if (wide) "wide"),
           tags$div(class = "k", label),
           tags$div(class = "v", value))
}
grid <- function(...) tags$div(class = "grid", ...)
sub_h <- function(x) tags$h4(class = "sub", x)

mini_table <- function(header, rows, empty = "None on record.") {
  if (length(rows) == 0) return(tags$p(class = "empty", empty))
  tags$div(class = "tbl-wrap", tags$table(class = "mini",
    tags$thead(tags$tr(lapply(header, tags$th))),
    tags$tbody(lapply(rows, function(cells) tags$tr(lapply(cells, tags$td))))
  ))
}

check <- function(label, on) {
  tags$span(class = paste("chk", if (isTRUE(on)) "on" else "off"),
            if (isTRUE(on)) "✓" else "✗", label)
}
```

```{r context, include=FALSE}
# Everything the page knows about one account, gathered once.
acct_ctx <- function(r) {
  nm <- r$name
  id <- r$account_id
  ren <- rows_for_id(op_list$renewals, id)
  if (!is.null(ren)) ren <- ren[order(as.Date(ren$`Current Contract End Date`)), , drop = FALSE]
  exp <- rows_for_id(op_list$expansions, id)
  if (!is.null(exp)) exp <- exp[order(as.Date(exp$`Close Date`)), , drop = FALSE]
  esc <- rows_for(op_list$escalations, nm)
  if (!is.null(esc)) esc <- esc[order(num(esc$severity_rank), -num(esc$age_days)), , drop = FALSE]
  list(
    rec        = r,
    acct       = rows_for(op_list$accounts, nm),
    lc         = rows_for(op_list$consumption$low_consumption, nm),
    pbac       = pbac_row(op_list, nm),
    sdd        = rows_for(op_list$consumption$sdd_consumption, nm, "Salesforce Accounts Account Name"),
    support    = rows_for(op_list$support, nm),
    esc        = esc,
    saas       = rows_for(op_list$saas_pipeline, nm),
    contacts   = rows_for(op_list$contacts, nm),
    renewals   = ren,
    expansions = exp,
    forecast   = rows_for_id(op_list$forecast, id),
    pb         = rows_for(op_list$product_board$by_account, nm, "account_name")
  )
}

# Data-driven prompts, each tied to an agenda question number. sev is
# "high" (likely risk), "med" (worth checking) or "info" (context).
build_prompts <- function(cx) {
  out <- list()
  add <- function(q, sev, text) out[[length(out) + 1]] <<- list(q = q, sev = sev, text = text)
  r <- cx$rec
  a <- cx$acct

  # Adoption ------------------------------------------------------------------
  pc <- pbac_rating_colour(r$pbac_rating)     # Looker-derived
  sc <- pbac_rating_colour(r$pbac_adoption)   # Salesforce picklist
  if (pc %in% c("red", "black")) {
    add(6, "high", sprintf("PBAC is rated %s (%s). Is it an enablement problem or a depth problem?",
                           cap1(pc), pbac_rating_label(r$pbac_rating)))
  }
  if (nzchar(pc) && nzchar(sc) && pc != sc) {
    add(6, "med", sprintf("Salesforce PBAC picklist says %s but the Looker rating is %s. Which is right?",
                          cap1(sc), cap1(pc)))
  }
  if (!is.null(cx$pbac)) {
    feats <- c(multi_platform = "multi-platform", dns_policies = "data + subscription policies",
               sdd = "Sensitive Data Discovery", domains = "Domains", guardrail = "guardrails")
    off <- feats[!vapply(names(feats), function(f) isTRUE(num(cx$pbac[[f]][1]) > 0), logical(1))]
    if (length(off) > 0) add(7, "info", paste0("Not seen in production: ", paste(off, collapse = ", "), "."))
  }
  m <- suppressWarnings(as.logical(first_val(a, "request_adoption_match")))
  if (isFALSE(m)) {
    add(8, "med", sprintf("Salesforce Request rating (%s) does not match the Looker stage (%s).",
                          .tile_stoplight_word(r$request_adoption), cap1(sv(r$request_status))))
  }
  cr <- r$consumption_ratio_raw
  if (!is.null(cr) && !is.na(cr) && cr < 0.75) {
    add(11, if (cr < 0.25) "high" else "med",
        sprintf("%s of licensed users are registered (%s of %s).",
                r$consumption_ratio, r$registered_users, r$licensed_users))
  }

  # Performance ---------------------------------------------------------------
  if (!isTRUE(r$is_saas)) {
    if (isTRUE(r$unsupported)) add(12, "high", "Self-managed on an unsupported Immuta version.")
    if (is.null(cx$saas)) {
      add(12, "med", "Self-managed, but not on the SaaS Migration pipeline.")
    } else {
      add(12, "info", sprintf("SaaS migration stage: %s (est. %s).",
                              sv(cx$saas$`SaaS Migration Pipeline Stage`),
                              sv(cx$saas$`Estimated SaaS Migration Period`)))
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(cx$esc)) {
    age   <- num(cx$esc$age_days)
    stale <- sum(!is.na(age) & age > 90)
    p1    <- any(num(cx$esc$severity_rank) == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    add(14, if (p1 || stale > 0) "high" else "med",
        sprintf("%d open CUSTX escalation%s%s%s.", nrow(cx$esc), if (nrow(cx$esc) == 1) "" else "s",
                if (p1) ", including a P1" else "",
                if (stale > 0) sprintf(", %d older than 90 days", stale) else ""))
  }
  c90 <- num(first_val(cx$support, "cases_90d"))
  if (length(c90) && !is.na(c90) && c90 >= 5) add(14, "med", sprintf("%d support cases in the last 90 days.", round(c90)))
  if (!is.null(cx$pb)) {
    add(16, "info", sprintf("Productboard: %s notes linked to %s feature requests.",
                            int_fmt(first_val(cx$pb, "note_count")),
                            int_fmt(first_val(cx$pb, "feature_request_count"))))
  }
  conn <- r$connections_raw
  if (!is.null(conn) && !is.na(conn) && conn < 1) {
    add(17, "med", sprintf("Connections not fully migrated: %s.", r$connections))
  }

  # Engagement ----------------------------------------------------------------
  if (is_dash(r$executive_buyer)) {
    add(20, "high", "No Executive Buyer recorded in Salesforce.")
  } else if (is_dash(r$buyer_relationship) || is_dash(r$buyer_influence)) {
    add(20, "med", "Executive Buyer relationship or influence is not rated.")
  }
  if (is_dash(r$champion)) {
    add(21, "high", "No Champion recorded in Salesforce.")
  } else if (is_dash(r$champion_relationship) || is_dash(r$champion_influence)) {
    add(21, "med", "Champion relationship or influence is not rated.")
  }
  lq <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(first_val(a, "Date Last QBR")))
  nq <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(first_val(a, "Date Next QBR")))
  if (is.na(lq)) {
    add(23, "high", "No QBR on record.")
  } else if (as.numeric(as_of - lq) > 180) {
    add(23, "med", sprintf("Last QBR was %d days ago (%s).", as.integer(as_of - lq), fmt_date(lq)))
  }
  if (is.na(nq) || nq < as_of) add(23, "med", "No upcoming QBR scheduled.")

  ren <- cx$renewals
  if (is.null(ren)) {
    add(24, "info", "No open renewal opportunity in Salesforce.")
  } else {
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(ren))) {
      x    <- ren[j, ]
      end  <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(x$`Current Contract End Date`))
      days <- if (is.na(end)) NA else as.integer(end - as_of)
      if (!is.na(days) && days <= 365) {
        add(24, if (days <= 180) "high" else "med",
            sprintf("%s (%s) ends %s, in %d days.", sv(x$`Opportunity Name`), fmt_usd(x$Amount),
                    fmt_date(end), days))
      }
      if (grepl("churn", sv(x$`Account Risk`), ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        add(24, "high", sprintf("%s is marked “%s”.", sv(x$`Opportunity Name`), sv(x$`Account Risk`)))
      }
      cf <- num(x$`Churn Forecast`)
      if (length(cf) && !is.na(cf) && cf > 0) {
        add(24, "high", sprintf("Churn forecast of %s on %s.", fmt_usd(cf), sv(x$`Opportunity Name`)))
      }
    }
  }
  out
}

# Why the (if time) questions apply: high ARR, near renewal, or at risk.
iftime_reasons <- function(cx, prompts) {
  r   <- cx$rec
  why <- character(0)
  ai  <- op_list$constants$arr_index
  hi  <- if (length(ai)) max(num(ai), na.rm = TRUE) else 5e5
  if (!is.null(r$arr_raw) && !is.na(r$arr_raw) && r$arr_raw >= hi) why <- c(why, paste0("ARR ≥ ", fmt_usd(hi)))
  ren <- cx$renewals
  if (!is.null(ren)) {
    end <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(ren$`Current Contract End Date`))
    if (any(!is.na(end) & end - as_of <= 180)) why <- c(why, "renewal within 180 days")
  }
  risky <- pbac_rating_colour(r$pbac_rating) %in% c("red", "black") ||
    any(vapply(prompts, function(p) p$q %in% c(14, 24) && p$sev == "high", logical(1)))
  if (risky) why <- c(why, "risk signals")
  why
}

ctxs    <- lapply(recs, acct_ctx)
prompts <- lapply(ctxs, build_prompts)
```

```{r panels, include=FALSE}
prompt_box <- function(p, qs) {
  p <- Filter(function(x) x$q %in% qs, p)
  if (length(p) == 0) return(tags$div(class = "prompts none", "No data flags for this segment."))
  ord <- order(match(vapply(p, `[[`, "", "sev"), c("high", "med", "info")),
               vapply(p, `[[`, 0, "q"))
  tags$div(class = "prompts",
    tags$div(class = "prompts-h", "From the data, ask about"),
    tags$ul(lapply(p[ord], function(x)
      tags$li(class = paste("sev", x$sev), tags$span(class = "qref", paste0("Q", x$q)), x$text))))
}

# 1. Snapshot -----------------------------------------------------------------
panel_snapshot <- function(cx, p = NULL) {
  r   <- cx$rec
  ren <- cx$renewals
  nxt <- if (!is.null(ren)) ren[1, ] else NULL
  rows <- adoption_rows(cx$acct, cx$pbac)
  tagList(
    grid(
      kv("Lifecycle stage", r$lifecycle_stage, wide = TRUE),
      kv("Customer for", fmt_days(first_val(ren, "Vitally Days as Customer"))),
      kv("Next contract end", if (is.null(nxt)) dash else fmt_date(nxt$`Current Contract End Date`)),
      kv("Renewal risk", if (is.null(nxt)) dash else sv(nxt$`Account Risk`)),
      kv("Churn quarter", sv(r$churn_summary))
    ),
    sub_h("Adoption stoplights"),
    tags$div(class = "lights", lapply(rows, function(x)
      tags$div(class = "light", dot(x$value),
               tags$span(class = "l-name", x$label), tags$span(class = "l-word", sv(x$word)),
               tags$span(class = "l-src", x$source)))),
    sub_h("Licensed products"),
    if (length(r$products) == 0) tags$p(class = "empty", "No active orders on record.") else
      tags$ul(class = "plain", lapply(r$products, function(p)
        tags$li(p$name, tags$span(class = "muted", paste0(" × ", int_fmt(p$quantity)))))),
    sub_h("Latest QBR note"),
    tags$p(class = "note", sv(r$qbr_note))
  )
}

# 2. Adoption -----------------------------------------------------------------
panel_adoption <- function(cx, p = NULL) {
  r  <- cx$rec
  lc <- cx$lc
  pb <- cx$pbac
  feat <- function(f) isTRUE(num(if (is.null(pb)) NA else pb[[f]][1]) > 0)
  tagList(
    grid(
      kv("PBAC rating (Looker)", dotted(r$pbac_rating, pbac_rating_label(r$pbac_rating))),
      kv("Complexity score", if (is.null(r$pbac_score) || is.na(r$pbac_score)) dash else format(r$pbac_score)),
      kv("Consumption ratio", r$consumption_ratio),
      kv("Registered / licensed", paste(r$registered_users, "/", r$licensed_users)),
      kv("Native query users, 31d", int_fmt(first_val(lc, "[Usage Metrics] Users with Native Platform Query (Last 31 Days)"))),
      kv("Prod instances", int_fmt(first_val(lc, "Prod Instance Count"))),
      kv("PBAC (Salesforce picklist)", dotted(r$pbac_adoption), wide = TRUE)
    ),
    sub_h("Q7: capabilities in production"),
    tags$div(class = "checks",
      check("Multi-platform", feat("multi_platform") || isTRUE(r$multiplatform)),
      check("Data + subscription policies", feat("dns_policies")),
      check("Sensitive Data Discovery", feat("sdd")),
      check("Domains", feat("domains")),
      check("Guardrails", feat("guardrail"))
    ),
    grid(
      kv("Platforms", HTML(r$platform_html), wide = TRUE),
      kv("Data sources", int_fmt(first_val(lc, "Data Sources Count"))),
      kv("Data policies", int_fmt(first_val(lc, "Data Policies"))),
      kv("Subscription policies", int_fmt(first_val(lc, "Subscription Policies"))),
      kv("Guardrail policies", int_fmt(first_val(lc, "Guardrail Policies"))),
      kv("Active policies (total)", int_fmt(first_val(lc, "Active Policies (Total)"))),
      kv("SDD tagged data sources", int_fmt(first_val(cx$sdd, "[Usage Metrics] Discover Tagged Datasources Distinct Count"))),
      kv("Days since last SDD run", int_fmt(first_val(cx$sdd, "Days since last SDD run"))),
      kv("Identity provider", if (nzchar(r$iam)) r$iam else "None"),
      kv("External catalog", if (nzchar(r$ext_catalog)) r$ext_catalog else "None")
    ),
    sub_h("Q8–9: Request, Comply, Agentic"),
    grid(
      kv("Request (Looker stage)", dotted(r$request_adoption_derived, cap1(sv(r$request_status)))),
      kv("Request (Salesforce)", dotted(r$request_adoption, .tile_stoplight_word(r$request_adoption))),
      kv("Ratings match?", {
        m <- suppressWarnings(as.logical(first_val(cx$acct, "request_adoption_match")))
        if (is.na(m)) dash else if (m) "Yes" else tags$b(class = "warn", "No")
      }),
      kv("Comply (Salesforce)", dotted(r$comply_adoption, .tile_stoplight_word(r$comply_adoption))),
      kv("Agentic Governance (Salesforce)", dotted(r$agentic_governance_adoption,
                                                   .tile_stoplight_word(r$agentic_governance_adoption)))
    )
  )
}

# 3. Performance --------------------------------------------------------------
panel_performance <- function(cx, p = NULL) {
  r  <- cx$rec
  s  <- cx$support
  esc_rows <- if (is.null(cx$esc)) list() else lapply(seq_len(nrow(cx$esc)), function(i) {
    e   <- cx$esc[i, ]
    age <- num(e$age_days)
    list(a_link(sv(e$key), e$url), sv(e$severity), sv(e$status),
         tagList(int_fmt(age), if (!is.na(age) && age > 90) tags$span(class = "badge stale", "stale")),
         sv(e$assignee), sv(e$summary))
  })
  sp <- cx$saas
  tagList(
    grid(
      kv("Deployment", if (isTRUE(r$is_saas)) "SaaS" else "Self-managed"),
      kv("Immuta version", r$immuta_version),
      kv("Unsupported version", if (isTRUE(r$is_saas)) "n/a (SaaS)" else if (isTRUE(r$unsupported)) tags$b(class = "warn", "Yes") else "No"),
      kv("Connections migrated", r$connections)
    ),
    sub_h("Q14: support history"),
    grid(
      kv("Cases, 90d", r$inc_90d),
      kv("Cases, 360d", r$inc_360d),
      kv("Cases, all time", int_fmt(first_val(s, "cases_total"))),
      kv("CUSTX, 90d", r$custx_90d),
      kv("CUSTX, 360d", int_fmt(first_val(s, "escalations_360d"))),
      kv("CUSTX open", r$custx_open)
    ),
    mini_table(c("Key", "Severity", "Status", "Age (days)", "Assignee", "Summary"), esc_rows,
               empty = "No open CUSTX escalations."),
    if (!isTRUE(r$is_saas) || !is.null(sp)) tagList(
      sub_h("Q12: SaaS migration"),
      if (is.null(sp)) tags$p(class = "empty", "Not on the SaaS Migration pipeline.") else grid(
        kv("Stage", sv(sp$`SaaS Migration Pipeline Stage`)),
        kv("Est. period", sv(sp$`Estimated SaaS Migration Period`)),
        kv("Est. date to move out of stage", fmt_date(sp$`Est. Date to Move Out of Stage (SM)`)),
        kv("Notes", sv(sp$`SaaS Migration Pipeline Notes`), wide = TRUE)
      )
    ),
    sub_h("Q16: feature requests (Productboard)"),
    if (is.null(op_list$product_board)) {
      tags$p(class = "empty", "Productboard was not pulled for this snapshot (run with productboard = TRUE).")
    } else if (is.null(cx$pb)) {
      tags$p(class = "empty", "No Productboard notes matched to this account.")
    } else {
      fn <- cx$pb$feature_names[[1]]
      tagList(
        grid(kv("Notes", int_fmt(first_val(cx$pb, "note_count"))),
             kv("Feature requests", int_fmt(first_val(cx$pb, "feature_request_count")))),
        if (length(fn)) tags$ul(class = "plain", lapply(unique(as.character(fn)), tags$li))
      )
    }
  )
}

# 4. Engagement ---------------------------------------------------------------
panel_engagement <- function(cx, p = NULL) {
  r  <- cx$rec
  a  <- cx$acct
  ct <- cx$contacts
  title_of <- function(flag) {
    if (is.null(ct) || !flag %in% names(ct)) return(dash)
    hit <- ct[ct[[flag]] %in% TRUE, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(hit) == 0) dash else sv(hit$contact_title)
  }
  person <- function(role, name, title, rel, inf) {
    tags$div(class = "person",
      tags$div(class = "p-role", role),
      tags$div(class = "p-name", name),
      tags$div(class = "p-title", title),
      tags$div(class = "p-rate", tags$span("Relationship: ", tags$b(rel)), tags$span("Influence: ", tags$b(inf))))
  }
  others <- if (is.null(ct)) list() else {
    o <- ct[!(ct$is_executive_buyer %in% TRUE) & !(ct$is_champion %in% TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(o)), function(i) list(sv(o$contact_name[i]), sv(o$contact_title[i]), sv(o$contact_role[i])))
  }
  ren <- cx$renewals
  ren_rows <- if (is.null(ren)) list() else lapply(seq_len(nrow(ren)), function(j) {
    x <- ren[j, ]
    list(a_link(sv(x$`Opportunity Name`), x$opportunity_url), fmt_usd(x$Amount),
         fmt_date(x$`Current Contract End Date`), sv(x$Stage), sv(x$`Churn Quarter`),
         sv(x$`Account Risk`), fmt_usd(x$`Churn Forecast`), sv(x$`Next Step`))
  })
  ex <- cx$expansions
  exp_rows <- if (is.null(ex)) list() else lapply(seq_len(nrow(ex)), function(j) {
    x <- ex[j, ]
    list(a_link(sv(x$`Opportunity Name`), x$opportunity_url), sv(x$`Opportunity Owner`),
         fmt_usd(x$Amount), sv(x$Stage), fmt_date(x$`Close Date`), sv(x$`Next Step`))
  })
  comments <- unique(c(
    if (!is.null(ren)) vapply(ren$`RD Comment`, sv, ""),
    if (!is.null(cx$forecast) && "CS Notes" %in% names(cx$forecast)) vapply(cx$forecast$`CS Notes`, sv, "")
  ))
  comments <- comments[comments != dash]
  tagList(
    tags$div(class = "people",
      person("Executive Buyer", r$executive_buyer, title_of("is_executive_buyer"),
             r$buyer_relationship, r$buyer_influence),
      person("Champion", r$champion, title_of("is_champion"),
             r$champion_relationship, r$champion_influence)
    ),
    sub_h("Q22: other contacts in Salesforce"),
    mini_table(c("Name", "Title", "Role"), others, empty = "No other contacts on record."),
    sub_h("Q23: QBR / EBR"),
    grid(
      kv("Last QBR", r$last_qbr),
      kv("Next QBR", r$next_qbr),
      kv("Last EBR", fmt_date(first_val(a, "Date of last EBR"))),
      kv("Next EBR", fmt_date(first_val(a, "Date of next EBR"))),
      kv("QBR note", r$qbr_note, wide = TRUE),
      kv("EBR note", sv(first_val(a, "EBR Note")), wide = TRUE)
    ),
    sub_h("Q24: renewals"),
    mini_table(c("Opportunity", "Amount", "Contract end", "Stage", "Churn qtr", "Risk", "Churn forecast", "Next step"),
               ren_rows, empty = "No open renewals."),
    if (length(comments)) tags$div(class = "comments", sub_h("Renewal comments"),
                                   tags$ul(class = "plain", lapply(comments, tags$li))),
    sub_h("Q24: expansions"),
    mini_table(c("Opportunity", "Owner", "Amount", "Stage", "Close date", "Next step"),
               exp_rows, empty = "No open expansions.")
  )
}

# 5. Close --------------------------------------------------------------------
panel_close <- function(cx, p) {
  items <- list()
  addi <- function(src, txt) if (!is_dash(txt)) items[[length(items) + 1]] <<- list(src, txt)
  if (!is.null(cx$renewals)) for (j in seq_len(nrow(cx$renewals)))
    addi(paste("Renewal:", sv(cx$renewals$`Opportunity Name`[j])), sv(cx$renewals$`Next Step`[j]))
  if (!is.null(cx$expansions)) for (j in seq_len(nrow(cx$expansions)))
    addi(paste("Expansion:", sv(cx$expansions$`Opportunity Name`[j])), sv(cx$expansions$`Next Step`[j]))
  if (!is.null(cx$saas)) addi("SaaS migration", sv(cx$saas$`SaaS Migration Pipeline Notes`))
  if (!is.null(cx$esc)) for (j in seq_len(nrow(cx$esc)))
    addi(paste("Escalation", sv(cx$esc$key[j])), paste0(sv(cx$esc$status[j]), ": ", sv(cx$esc$summary[j])))
  risks <- Filter(function(x) x$sev == "high", p)
  tagList(
    sub_h("Q28: open next steps already in the systems"),
    mini_table(c("Source", "Next step / status"), items, empty = "No recorded next steps."),
    sub_h("Q29: risk signals in the data (test the top three against these)"),
    if (length(risks) == 0) tags$p(class = "empty", "No high-severity flags.") else
      tags$ul(class = "plain", lapply(risks, function(x)
        tags$li(tags$span(class = "qref", paste0("Q", x$q)), x$text)))
  )
}
```

```{r agenda, include=FALSE}
# Agenda questions come from a standalone markdown file (params$questions_file)
# so the wording can be edited without touching this Rmd.

# Resolve a relative path: next to this Rmd, then working_scratch/, then root.
q_path <- params$questions_file
if (!grepl("^(/|~|[A-Za-z]:)", q_path)) {
  rmd_dir <- tryCatch(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), error = function(e) NULL)
  cands <- c(if (length(rmd_dir) && !is.na(rmd_dir)) file.path(rmd_dir, q_path),
             file.path(root, "working_scratch", q_path),
             file.path(root, q_path))
  hit <- cands[file.exists(cands)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) stop("Questions file not found: ", q_path, " (looked in ", paste(cands, collapse = ", "), ")")
  q_path <- hit[1]
}
if (!file.exists(q_path)) stop("Questions file not found: ", q_path)

# **bold** -> <b>bold</b>, after escaping everything else.
md_inline <- function(x) gsub("\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*", "<b>\\1</b>", html_escape(x), perl = TRUE)

read_questions <- function(path) {
  txt   <- paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n")
  txt   <- gsub("<!--.*?-->", "", txt, perl = TRUE)          # drop comments
  lines <- strsplit(txt, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  segs   <- list()
  cur    <- NULL
  last_q <- FALSE
  flush  <- function() if (!is.null(cur)) segs[[length(segs) + 1]] <<- cur

  for (ln in lines) {
    if (grepl("^##\\s+\\d+\\.", ln)) {
      flush()
      m   <- regmatches(ln, regexec("^##\\s+(\\d+)\\.\\s*(.+?)\\s*$", ln, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
      cur <- list(n = as.integer(m[2]), title = m[3], time = "", mins = NA_integer_,
                  where = "", qs = list())
      last_q <- FALSE
    } else if (is.null(cur)) {
      next
    } else if (grepl("^-\\s*\\*\\*Time:\\*\\*", ln)) {
      v  <- trimws(sub("^-\\s*\\*\\*Time:\\*\\*", "", ln))
      mm <- regmatches(v, regexec("^(.*?)\\s*\\((\\d+)\\s*min\\)\\s*$", v, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
      if (length(mm)) { cur$time <- mm[2]; cur$mins <- as.integer(mm[3]) } else cur$time <- v
      last_q <- FALSE
    } else if (grepl("^-\\s*\\*\\*Where to look", ln)) {
      cur$where <- trimws(sub("^-\\s*\\*\\*Where to look[^*]*\\*\\*", "", ln))
      last_q <- FALSE
    } else if (grepl("^\\d+\\.\\s+\\*\\*\\((core|if time)\\)\\*\\*", ln)) {
      m <- regmatches(ln, regexec("^(\\d+)\\.\\s+\\*\\*\\((core|if time)\\)\\*\\*\\s*(.*)$", ln, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
      cur$qs[[length(cur$qs) + 1]] <- list(n = as.integer(m[2]),
                                           tier = if (m[3] == "core") "core" else "if",
                                           raw = m[4])
      last_q <- TRUE
    } else if (last_q && grepl("^\\s+\\S", ln)) {           # indented continuation
      k <- length(cur$qs)
      cur$qs[[k]]$raw <- paste(cur$qs[[k]]$raw, trimws(ln))
    } else if (!nzchar(trimws(ln))) {
      last_q <- FALSE
    }
  }
  flush()

  if (length(segs) == 0) stop("No '## <n>. <Title>' segments found in ", path)
  for (k in seq_along(segs)) {
    if (length(segs[[k]]$qs) == 0) stop("Segment '", segs[[k]]$title, "' in ", path, " has no questions")
    segs[[k]]$qs <- lapply(segs[[k]]$qs, function(q) { q$text <- md_inline(q$raw); q })
  }
  all_q <- unlist(lapply(segs, function(s) vapply(s$qs, function(q) q$n, 0L)))
  if (anyDuplicated(all_q)) stop("Duplicate question numbers in ", path, ": ",
                                 paste(unique(all_q[duplicated(all_q)]), collapse = ", "))
  segs
}

# Metrics panel for each segment number. A segment numbered outside 1-5 gets
# questions only.
panel_by_seg <- list(`1` = panel_snapshot, `2` = panel_adoption, `3` = panel_performance,
                     `4` = panel_engagement, `5` = panel_close)
no_panel <- function(cx, p = NULL) tags$p(class = "empty", "No ImmuteR metrics for this segment.")

segments <- lapply(read_questions(q_path), function(s) {
  s$panel <- panel_by_seg[[as.character(s$n)]]
  if (is.null(s$panel)) s$panel <- no_panel
  s$time_label <- if (is.na(s$mins)) s$time else paste0(s$time, " · ", s$mins, " min")
  s
})

# The data flags in build_prompts() point at these question numbers. If the
# questions file no longer has one, its flags would silently vanish, so say so
# on the page instead.
flag_qs   <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(prompts, function(p) vapply(p, function(x) x$q, 0)))))
present_q <- unlist(lapply(segments, function(s) vapply(s$qs, function(q) q$n, 0L)))
orphan_q  <- setdiff(flag_qs, present_q)
```

```{r page, include=FALSE}
# Account headers (one per account; only the selected one shows) ---------------
acct_heads <- lapply(seq_along(recs), function(i) {
  r  <- recs[[i]]
  cx <- ctxs[[i]]
  p  <- prompts[[i]]
  why <- iftime_reasons(cx, p)
  flagged <- sort(unique(vapply(Filter(function(x) x$sev != "info", p), function(x) x$q, 0)))
  n_high  <- sum(vapply(p, function(x) x$sev == "high", logical(1)))
  n_med   <- sum(vapply(p, function(x) x$sev == "med", logical(1)))
  sf_url  <- first_val(cx$acct, "account_url")
  tags$div(class = "acct-head", `data-acct` = acct_ids[i],
           `data-flags` = paste(flagged, collapse = " "),
           `data-iftime` = if (length(why)) "1" else "0",
    tags$div(class = "ah-top",
      tags$div(class = "ah-name",
        tags$h2(r$name),
        tags$div(class = "ah-arr", r$arr, tags$span(class = "ah-arr-l", "ARR"))),
      tags$div(class = "ah-links",
        if (!is.null(sf_url) && !is.na(sf_url) && nzchar(sf_url))
          tags$a(class = "cc-link", href = sf_url, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", "Salesforce ↗"),
        if (nzchar(r$customer_central_url))
          tags$a(class = "cc-link", href = r$customer_central_url, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", "Customer Central ↗"),
        if (nzchar(r$consumption_link)) HTML(r$consumption_link))),
    tags$div(class = "chips",
      tags$span(class = "tag tag-region", r$region),
      if (isTRUE(r$is_saas)) tags$span(class = "tag tag-saas", "SaaS")
      else if (isTRUE(r$unsupported)) tags$span(class = "tag tag-sm-unsup", "Self-managed · unsupported")
      else tags$span(class = "tag tag-sm-sup", "Self-managed"),
      if (nzchar(r$churn_summary)) tags$span(class = "tag tag-churn", paste("Churn", r$churn_summary)),
      tags$span(class = "tag tag-plain", dot(r$pbac_rating), "PBAC ", pbac_rating_label(r$pbac_rating))),
    tags$div(class = "team",
      tags$div(tags$div(class = "field-label", "CSM"), tags$div(class = "field-value", r$csm)),
      tags$div(tags$div(class = "field-label", "Account Owner"), tags$div(class = "field-value", r$account_owner)),
      tags$div(tags$div(class = "field-label", "Field CTO"), tags$div(class = "field-value", r$field_cto)),
      tags$div(tags$div(class = "field-label", "Lifecycle"), tags$div(class = "field-value", r$lifecycle_stage))),
    tags$div(class = "ah-flags",
      tags$span(class = "flagcount high", n_high, " high"),
      tags$span(class = "flagcount med", n_med, " to check"),
      tags$span(class = paste("iftime", if (length(why)) "on" else "off"),
        if (length(why)) paste0("Ask the (if time) questions: ", paste(why, collapse = ", "))
        else "Core questions only: not high-ARR, near renewal, or flagged at risk"))
  )
})
```

```{r render}
seg_html <- lapply(segments, function(sg) {
  qn <- vapply(sg$qs, function(q) q$n, 0)
  tags$section(class = "seg", id = paste0("seg-", sg$n),
    tags$div(class = "seg-head",
      tags$span(class = "seg-num", sg$n),
      tags$h3(sg$title),
      if (nzchar(sg$time_label)) tags$span(class = "seg-time", sg$time_label),
      tags$span(class = "seg-where", paste("ImmuteR:", sg$where))),
    tags$div(class = "seg-body",
      tags$ol(class = "qs",
        lapply(sg$qs, function(q)
          tags$li(class = paste("q", q$tier), value = q$n, `data-q` = q$n,
                  tags$span(class = "tier", if (q$tier == "core") "core" else "if time"),
                  HTML(q$text)))),
      tags$div(class = "data",
        lapply(seq_along(recs), function(i)
          tags$div(class = "acct-panel", `data-acct` = acct_ids[i],
            prompt_box(prompts[[i]], qn),
            sg$panel(ctxs[[i]], prompts[[i]])))))
  )
})

intro <- tags$details(class = "intro",

In 30 minutes per account, we want to capture what you know, especially the things that are not written down in Salesforce, Jira, or ImmuteR, so that the new CSMs, regional Solution Architects, and Field CTOs can pick up each account with context. ",
           tags$b("We are asking you for what the system cannot show:"), " the history, the relationships, the commitments, and your judgment."),

    tags$div(class = "cols",
```

```{css, echo=FALSE}
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap");

/* Palette and tokens copied from report_all_accounts_html() (immuta_accounts.html)
   so this guide reads as part of the same ImmuteR family. Light theme only. */
:root {
  --im-black:   #0D0D0D;
  --im-lime:    #C8F135;
  --im-lime-dk: #A8CC18;
  --im-lime-lt: #F5FCD8;
  --im-white:   #FFFFFF;

  --green:    #22C55E;
  --amber:    #F59E0B;
  --amber-lt: #FEF3C7;
  --red:      #EF4444;
  --red-lt:   #FEE2E2;

  --text-1:    #111111;
  --text-2:    #555555;
  --text-3:    #999999;
  --border:    #E5E5E5;
  --surface:   #F8F8F6;
  --surface-2: #F0F0EE;

  --radius:    10px;
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --shadow:    0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
  --font:      "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-1);
  font-family: var(--font); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
a { color: var(--text-1); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--im-lime-dk); text-underline-offset: 2px; }
a:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--im-black); }
.main-container, .container-fluid { max-width: none !important; padding: 0 !important; margin: 0 !important; }

/* ── Top bar (black, as on the Accounts page) ─────────────────────────── */
.topbar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center;
  gap: 10px 20px; min-height: 60px; padding: 10px 24px; background: var(--im-black); color: var(--im-white); }
.topbar-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.topbar-logo svg { display: block; }
.topbar-section { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.55); padding-left: 14px;
  border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); white-space: nowrap; }
.tb-ctrl { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; flex: 1 1 360px; max-width: 620px; }
.select-outer { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
#acct-select { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; width: 100%; font-family: var(--font);
  font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 30px 8px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); color: var(--im-white);
  cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: border-color .15s, background .15s; }
#acct-select:focus, #acct-select:hover { border-color: var(--im-lime); background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); }
#acct-select option { color: var(--text-1); background: var(--im-white); }
.select-chevron { position: absolute; right: 11px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
  font-size: 9px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); pointer-events: none; }
.nav { width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: none;
  background: var(--im-lime); color: var(--im-black); font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background .14s; }
.nav:hover { background: var(--im-lime-dk); }
.count-badge { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.45); white-space: nowrap; margin-left: auto; }

/* ── Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.wrap { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 22px 28px 48px; }
.intro, .acct-head, .seg { background: var(--im-white); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.hero { padding: 18px 2px 20px; }
.hero h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 40px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -1.2px; line-height: 1.1; }
.hero h1::after { content: ""; display: block; width: 72px; height: 5px; margin-top: 14px;
  background: var(--im-lime); border-radius: 3px; }
.hero-sub { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-2); }
.hero-warn { margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px;
  background: var(--amber-lt); color: #92400E; border: 1px solid #FCD34D; }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .hero h1 { font-size: 30px; } }
.intro { padding: 12px 18px; }
.intro summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
.intro summary::marker { color: var(--im-lime-dk); }
.intro-body { padding-top: 6px; }
.intro p { margin: 8px 0; }
.intro h4 { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-3); margin: 12px 0 6px; }
.intro .cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; }
.intro ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; }
.intro dt { font-weight: 600; } .intro dd { margin: 0 0 6px 0; color: var(--text-2); }

/* ── Account header card ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.acct-head { padding: 16px 20px; border-color: var(--im-black); }
.ah-top { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; }
.ah-name h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.3px; }
.ah-arr { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.5px; }
.ah-arr-l { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--text-3); margin-left: 6px; }
.ah-links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.consumption-link, .cc-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--im-black); transition: background .14s, color .14s; }
.consumption-link { background: var(--im-lime); }
.consumption-link:hover { background: var(--im-lime-dk); }
.cc-link { background: var(--im-white); border: 1.5px solid var(--im-black); }
.cc-link:hover { background: var(--im-black); color: var(--im-lime); }
.chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 12px 0; }
.tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600;
  padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid transparent; }
.tag-region   { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-2); border-color: var(--border); }
.tag-plain    { background: var(--im-white); color: var(--text-1); border-color: var(--border); }
.tag-saas     { background: var(--im-lime-lt); color: #5A7A00; border-color: #C8E870; }
.tag-sm-sup   { background: var(--amber-lt); color: #92400E; border-color: #FCD34D; }
.tag-sm-unsup { background: var(--red-lt); color: #991B1B; border-color: #FCA5A5; }
.tag-churn    { background: var(--amber-lt); color: #92400E; border-color: #FCD34D; }
.team { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); margin-bottom: 12px; }
.field-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--text-3); margin-bottom: 3px; }
.field-value { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; }
.ah-flags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; }
.flagcount { border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 9px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid transparent; }
.flagcount.high { background: var(--red-lt); color: #991B1B; border-color: #FCA5A5; }
.flagcount.med  { background: var(--amber-lt); color: #92400E; border-color: #FCD34D; }
.iftime { padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 4px; }
.iftime.on  { background: var(--im-black); color: var(--im-lime); font-weight: 600; }
.iftime.off { color: var(--text-3); }

/* ── Agenda segments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.seg { overflow: hidden; }
.seg-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 12px; padding: 12px 20px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--im-lime); }
.seg-num { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--im-black); color: var(--im-lime);
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 800; }
.seg-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.15px; }
.seg-time { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--im-lime-lt); color: #5A7A00; }
.seg-where { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-3); margin-left: auto; }
.seg-body { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 5fr) 7fr; }
.qs { margin: 0; padding: 16px 18px 16px 44px; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); }
.qs li::marker { font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-3); }
.q { margin-bottom: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--text-1); }
.q .tier { display: inline-block; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .8px;
  padding: 1px 6px; margin-right: 6px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-3); vertical-align: 1px; }
.q.core .tier { background: var(--im-black); border-color: var(--im-black); color: var(--im-lime); }
body.iftime-off .q.if { opacity: .4; }
.q.flagged { background: var(--amber-lt); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--amber); }
.data { padding: 16px 20px; min-width: 0; }

/* ── Data-driven prompts ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.prompts { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.prompts.none { color: var(--text-3); font-size: 13px; font-style: italic; }
.prompts-h, .sub { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.2px; color: var(--text-3); }
.prompts-h { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.prompts ul { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.prompts li { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); margin: 4px 0; font-size: 13px; border-left: 3px solid transparent; }
.sev.high { background: var(--red-lt); border-left-color: var(--red); }
.sev.med  { background: var(--amber-lt); border-left-color: var(--amber); }
.sev.info { background: var(--im-lime-lt); border-left-color: var(--im-lime-dk); }
.qref { display: inline-block; min-width: 34px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-2); }

/* ── Fields, stoplights, tables ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.sub { margin: 18px 0 8px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.kv { min-width: 0; }
.kv.wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.kv .k { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--text-3); margin-bottom: 3px; }
.kv .v { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.dot { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 6px; vertical-align: middle;
  flex-shrink: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.15); background: var(--surface-2); }
.dot.green { background: var(--green); } .dot.amber { background: var(--amber); }
.dot.red { background: var(--red); } .dot.black { background: #111111; }
.dotted { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-weight: 600; }
.lights { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
.light { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 7px 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.l-name { font-weight: 700; } .l-word { flex: 1; color: var(--text-2); }
.l-src { font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .8px; color: var(--text-3); text-transform: uppercase; }
.checks { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.chk { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.chk.on  { background: var(--im-lime); color: var(--im-black); }
.chk.off { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-3); }
.warn { color: #991B1B; }
.badge.stale { margin-left: 6px; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .6px;
  background: var(--red-lt); color: #991B1B; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 3px; }
.tbl-wrap { overflow-x: auto; margin-bottom: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
table.mini { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 13px; }
table.mini th { text-align: left; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--text-3); padding: 7px 12px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); white-space: nowrap; }
table.mini td { padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--surface-2); vertical-align: top; }
table.mini tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
table.mini tr:hover td { background: var(--im-lime-lt); }
.people { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
.person { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-left: 3px solid var(--im-lime); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 10px 14px; }
.p-role { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--text-3); }
.p-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; } .p-title { color: var(--text-2); font-size: 13px; }
.p-rate { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; font-size: 12.5px; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--text-2); }
.p-rate b { color: var(--text-1); }
.plain { margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; }
.empty, .muted { color: var(--text-3); } .empty { font-style: italic; font-size: 13px; }
.note { white-space: pre-wrap; margin: 0; }
.outro { color: var(--text-2); padding: 6px 4px; }
.outro h4 { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-3); }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .seg-body { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .qs { border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .people, .intro .cols { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .seg-where, .count-badge { margin-left: 0; }
  .topbar, .wrap { padding-left: 16px; padding-right: 16px; }
}
@media print {
  .topbar { position: static; } .tb-ctrl, .intro { display: none; }
  .seg { break-inside: avoid-page; box-shadow: none; }
}
```

```{js, echo=FALSE}
(function () {
  var sel = document.getElementById('acct-select');
  if (!sel) return;
  function show(id) {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-acct]').forEach(function (el) {
      el.hidden = el.getAttribute('data-acct') !== id;
    });
    var head  = document.querySelector('.acct-head[data-acct="' + id + '"]');
    var flags = head ? (head.getAttribute('data-flags') || '').split(' ') : [];
    document.querySelectorAll('.q').forEach(function (q) {
      q.classList.toggle('flagged', flags.indexOf(q.getAttribute('data-q')) >= 0);
    });
    document.body.classList.toggle('iftime-off', !!head && head.getAttribute('data-iftime') !== '1');
    if (history.replaceState) history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + id);
  }
  function step(d) {
    var i = sel.selectedIndex + d, n = sel.options.length;
    sel.selectedIndex = (i + n) % n;
    show(sel.value);
  }
  sel.addEventListener('change', function () { show(sel.value); });
  document.getElementById('prev-acct').addEventListener('click', function () { step(-1); });
  document.getElementById('next-acct').addEventListener('click', function () { step(1); });
  var h = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1));
  for (var i = 0; i < sel.options.length; i++) if (sel.options[i].value === h) sel.selectedIndex = i;
  show(sel.value);
})();
```
